name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.compileWord_termD_one
typeText:
∀ (d : Nat) (rels : List.{0} (List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} (Fin d))))
  (w : List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} (Fin d)))
  (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.compileWord d rels w)),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.termD (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.compileWord d rels w) hv 1)
    (DisequalityDispersion.SigEquiv.rename (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.compileSig d rels w)
      (DisequalityDispersion.Term.var Bool.true))

source.code:
theorem compileWord_termD_one (hv : (compileWord d rels w).Valid) :
    (compileWord d rels w).termD hv 1 = (compileSig d rels w).rename (.var true) := by
  have h := compileWord_nodes_one d rels w
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨h0, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hi, hta⟩ := (compileWord d rels w).decode_src hv 1 1 h0 h
  rw [hta]
  exact congrArg Term.var (Fin.ext (compileSig_eV_true d rels w).symm)
